items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: had another knick knack in the band -- George Washington, trombone player.

ctx.x: Anyway, after I give him his birthday present, everything was lovely. And all was forgotten and forgiven. But we

had another knick knack in the band -- George Washington, trombone player. He was sort of on the byside. He was 21 before he even knew whether he wanted to be a man or a woman. And he accidentally married a woman. And he had a son, but as years went by, he felt this other thing coming out stronger. So he had a love affair with Israel Crosby, the late Israel Crosby. And they would lay on the back seat of the busses, from town to town. But invariably, once a month, we would have to leave George Washington, just…
